# The Perceptron

A perceptron trained from scratch and with scikit-learn.

## Run

Python 3.10+ with NumPy and scikit-learn.

From this folder:

```sh
python -m pip install numpy scikit-learn
python perceptron_from_scratch.py
python perceptron_scikit.py
```
